# charly bpf — BPF/eBPF kernel-feature readiness

`charly bpf` is the one canonical surface for BPF kernel-feature readiness on any
venue (bare host or VM guest). It is served by `candy/plugin-bpf` (a `command:bpf`
+ `verb:bpf` plugin).

## Command tree

- `charly bpf status` — the kernel BPF readiness report.
- `charly bpf lsm` — the active LSM list (the BPF-LSM gate BPF-LSM-gated tools need),
  read from `/sys/kernel/security/lsm`.
- `charly bpf config` — the kernel config facts (`CONFIG_BPF_LSM`,
  `CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF`), BTF availability, the BPF sysctl knobs, memlock, lockdown.
- `charly bpf probe` — a verify-only attach-requirements report. A real transient
  attach probe requires an explicit `--attach` flag + root + bpftool.

All reads are READ-ONLY and direct — no shelling out. The plugin also serves the
declarative `bpf:` check verb for candy plans.

## When to use it

Before running BPF-LSM-gated tooling (e.g. cardwire) to confirm the kernel supports
it, or when diagnosing why a BPF program cannot attach.
